title: Model Code Decoder
description: Designation decoder: for eight Twin City Fan designations (model, size, class, arrangement) the learner decides Offered or Not offered and picks the class maximum RPM from Catalog 902 and Catalog 300 extracts; both answers must match, one scored attempt plus one unscored practice try.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: model code
fan size
fan class
arrangement
maximum RPM
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Checking a fan designation against catalog availability and maximum speed
learningObjectives: The learner will interpret a Twin City Fan designation (model code, size, class, arrangement) by judging whether it is offered and reading its class maximum RPM from catalog extracts, for at least 7 of 8 designations.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); designations, verdicts and the summary are announced through FP.announce (aria-live); answer buttons are aria-pressed toggles and extract buttons carry aria-expanded; each answer is marked with ✓ right / ✗ wrong text and the feedback panel pairs ✓/✗ with solid/dashed borders; keys O, N, 1-5, Enter, A, B.

controls.label: Maximum RPM values and none
controls.purpose: Second answer: the class maximum RPM from that model's row, or none (keys 1-5)

controls.label: Extract A: Catalog 902 / Extract B: Catalog 300
controls.purpose: Open or collapse a catalog extract (keys A, B)

controls.label: Check / Practice try
controls.purpose: Score the two answers; after a miss, one unscored practice try (Enter)

controls.label: Next designation
controls.purpose: Go to the next designation; after the eighth, Show summary (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Back to designation 1 with the score cleared

rules: Offered when the arrangement appears in the list for that model, size and class; Not offered otherwise, including when the class is not built for that size
The class maximum RPM answer is the value in the extract for that class, or none when the class is not built
Both answers must match for the designation to count as correct
One scored attempt per designation, then one unscored practice try; mastery is 7 of 8 on the first attempt
assumptions: BC-SW and BC-DW arrangement lists are those Catalog 300 page 3 gives for the model, for every class
limitations: Extracts cover four model rows only; check the current catalog for other sizes

sources: Twin City Fan Catalog 902, RB Industrial Fans (November 2017), page 13 (RB Series Availability), pages 20 and 24 (diameters, maximum RPM)
Twin City Fan Catalog 300, BC Backward Inclined Fans (April 2024), page 3 (arrangements by model), page 16 (maximum RPM)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Cross-reference availability and maximum-speed tables for realistic designations, with feedback that names the wrong part
keyQuestions: Can the factory build this fan, and how fast can it run?
Is this arrangement in the list for this model, size and class?
commonMisconceptions: If a size is offered in a class and an arrangement is offered in the line, every combination is offered.
A direct-drive arrangement is available in every class.
A size number means the same diameter in every model.
assessmentOpportunities: Score 'Designations correct: n of 8'; mastery is 7 of 8 on the first attempt; the summary lists missed designations with their answers.
